qa_inventory(app, as?, user?, paths?, max_pages?, follow_links?, surface_only?, width?, height?, budget_seconds?)   # editor role (it signs in as `as`); loads pages, never clicks
browser_batch(app, journeys[], as?, budget_seconds?)   # editor role; runs up to 40 journeys per call on one Chrome, isolated tab per journey
browser_check(app, path, as?, actions?, script?, ...)  # single page, fresh Chrome - use for exploratory work
benmore verify [dir] [--quick|--release]                # runs tests/journeys/*.yaml through browser_batch, resubmitting `pending` until empty

browser_check, browser_batch and qa_inventory's crawl run against the dev instance only when the app has one; env:"prod" is refused (qa_inventory surface_only:true still reads any instance). An app with only a prod instance keeps it as the target.
